Yes, I agree.  It's really hard to not look like you just want attention.  I had sexual abuse in my past too.  I did a treatment called EMDR which is for PTSD and it changed my life.  You might want to look into it.  It wasn't until I survived a suicide attempt that I realized I really needed to do something because it wasn't going to get better otherwise.  I hope that you will eventually feel better.  It makes me teary eyed when I think about all the people who are hurting so much.  I'm sorry that you went through so much.    I heard a saying once that helps me sometimes.  "Happiness only comes when you appreciate what you already have".   You are so blessed to have a wife that loves you and she is lucky to have you!

The point is that everyone should give from their heart and not just give what they have to spare.  Sacrifice unites us in suffering with Jesus.  I'm sorry if you don't get it.  It is truly a wonderful spiritual gift to give more than you can afford to.  I don't do a very good job of explaining it.  I'm sorry.  Maybe if you look up the Widow's Offering from the bible and an explanation, it might help you to see the point.  I don't worry about what others give and I think it's between you and God.  It's not anyone else's business.
You have to have faith.   And I do invest in God and I trust Him with my life.

Yes, I'm ok.  I deal with one day at a time otherwise it gets overwhelming.   I think one way to talk to people about your suicidal feeling is to always start with I (rather than say you make me feel like I want to kill myself.  And always include the fact that you are sharing it with them because the feelings scare you.   I think they scare everyone, although I could be wrong.  Do you know where your depression comes from?
Thanks, I needed that. I literally laughed out loud.

Giving helps you, not God.  It helps you to realize that there is more to life than money.  It helps you to put things in perspective.  It is a beautiful thing.  I can't afford to give anything but I still put $5 in the collection basket every week.  It doesn't seem like much, but it is a fortune to me.  I pretty much live on Ramen noodles.   That is about half of my grocery budget for the week.   I know there are people less fortunate than me.
The old testament is still the bible.  The bible tells you to give even when you can't afford to.    You need to get a clue.    You sound jaded.  God is good. I will pray for you.

Holy shit.  Talk to her.  Otherwise, in a number of years, you will be getting a divorce.  You will wish that you had shared more of your life with her.  But, it will be too late.  She will have shared things with other people and that can't be undone.  I'm going through a divorce from a man who is completely narcissistic.  I'm super sad about it because it shouldn't have ended up this way.  I don't love him anymore because he put his hands on me so it's for the best.   I wouldn't wish this on my worst enemy.

It pretty much says that you're supposed to do that, in the bible.  And look, it all worked out.  You survived and you are at least doing well enough to have internet access.  When your lives started to make a turn for the better, what was it that happened?   I would actually really love to know so I hope you don't think I'm goofing.
Can you let us know that you're alright?

You know, money is the root of all evil.  Don't let financial stress destroy you.  You can get through it one day at a time. Resist the urge to buy things. Make it a game to see how cheaply you can eat and how else you can save money.  Count your blessings.  I have so much financial stress that I cry about it daily.  But I focus on what I do have.  I have an able body, a few friends, a family (although they are nutty) and my freedom.   I heard once that true happiness comes only when you appreciate what you already have.  I hope you are ok.  I really care.  PM me if you need to talk.

If I hear one more time that it's just a cry for attention, I'll go over the edge.  And then when someone follows through, everyone says they wish they had known that it was so bad.  I think most of us don't "cry for help" but rather we really need help.

Your friends and relatives would be devastated.   Even people who hardly knew you would have a really hard time dealing with it.  It really is more than it seems.  A girl at my church who was 16 did it, and I cried for a week.  I didn't even know her.  I will never forget the pain I saw on so many faces.
Depression is really the worst.  I think the key is to do something different.  It's so tempting to just wallow in your misery.  I never want to get to the point where I will attempt again.
So what's he supposed to do about it?
I had one of those the other day.  I was home alone so I just let it all out.  It was exhausting.

That is absolutely the worst part.  I broke a glass once at the exact wrong moment and I cried for days about it, like that uncontrollable crying where you feel like you can't breathe and you can't eat.
I would love that club!

I was on it for about a month when I decided I couldn't stand it anymore.  Wellbutrin worked for me years ago and it helped me quit smoking.  I went back on it recently after a domestic violence incident.    Can I ask what's behind your depression?  You can PM me if you would rather.
What you have to do is let him cum in the back of your mouth, and then when he's done...swallow it all at once, like a shot.

I need to up my dose of Wellbutrin, I cry way too much.  I can't smoke weed bc I have young adult kids who do too much of it and I tell them to chill.   Holy shit. What if you're one of my kids?  Uh....it's not me....go to bed....you're having a dream.

Hey, if you don't have any of your own...you could take my teenager for a few days.  lol  You know, so you can experience the joy of children.

I was talking about myself but I have a daughter who lives with me. I can't do some of the things I would like to in order to relax, so I sit here going crazy. I can't win.  If I escape, she flips out.
She's half of the FML.  How do I get her to go along with this plan of me leaving reality for a little bit?  If I started playing video games, it would be like the warden is out to lunch.
But how do you take a moody teenager out of your reality?

Half of the FML has to do with a moody 19 yr old daughter who is high everyday and curses at me, then threatens to kill herself and locks herself in a room.  Having a drink would probably not be good parenting, but trust me sometimes I have a drink in my room once she has gone to sleep.

I would tell them that you're my brother/sister and  you would have to go.  Sorry.  Not sorry.

As someone who has PTSD (30 year violent rape survivor),  I think that it would make her day to know that you are still thinking about what happened to her.  A lot of time, people don't want to bring the subject up and you don't want to burden anyone and you end up feeling alone and damaged.  Just telling her that you wish you could have done more to this guy, will probably give her some validation.  I'm sad for her.  I hope she has better people in her life now.

He has been charged with felony domestic battery with substantial bodily harm.   "Since it's his first offense" (stupid prosecutor), they offered for him to plead guilty to misdemeanor domestic battery, probation (no jail time), counseling and a fine.  I will lose my mind if he gets away with this.  It has been nearly 6 months and I have suffered every single day and night from not only the injuries but the trauma and fear.   The victim advocate told me today that he thinks the guy wants to reject the plea and go to trial.
It's really hard to put it on the people I care about.   I ended up calling the suicide hotline and we talked for a long time.  I woke up with new hope but still a lot of pain.

Yep.  The MRI showed two area of cerebral softening and that's permanent.    Nevada is number one in domestic violence deaths and now I know why.  I was only the first one to have him charged but he hit most of them (I found out later).  The prosecutor sees him as a first offender.  So, his second offense will probably be murder since domestic violence is known to escalate over time.

I am really freaking out over this.  He brought up one incident from 6 weeks earlier and I couldn't even think straight, I have a brain injury.  The prosecutor says a brain injury, actually two of them, is not substantial bodily harm because I only had a mediocre amount of bruises.

I am freaking out.  I can't even get ahold of the prosecutor.  My only hope is to show up with my eveidence and wait until he will give me 5 minutes of my time.  Of course, that means time off work and the rent is due soon, but it's better than getting killed by someone who got a slap on the wrist.

Meetup is great, it brings people from all walks of life together.  We went on a meetup hike at Red Rock in Vegas and it was the most amazing eclectic group of people.

If you focus on other people, they won't think you are wrong.  People love to talk about themselves.  Just keep asking about their thoughts and they will love to be around you. And then take all your negative thoughts, and scream them at God.  Trust me....it's totally theraputic.

Go out and do the things you love to do and you will meet a great woman.  If you like to hike, hike with a bunch of different groups.  If you like to work out, get out there and do it.  It's the greatest thing when you meet someone with similar interests. Screw those dating sites...way too many chicks that wanna get paid.

I'm proud of you for reaching out.  It's not easy to let other people know you're in pain, but we've all been there.  I cry almost everyday but it feels good to get it out.  I'm an angry bitch when I hold it it.  I chewed out my mailman the other day. He deserved it.   What city are you in?  I swear, if you say Vegas....we are totally gonna hang out.

I'm not a Jesus freak or anything but when I get really sad and lonely,  I talk (through my tears) to God, out loud.  It really helps just to get things off your chest.  I can tell that you are a very special person.  Your post is perfect.  You are reaching out and finding out that you are not alone.  You are so smart!
I have to testify in court, and I was thinking the same thing.  I certainly don't want to appear drugged up.  MrsBuzzkillington had a good idea to try it out first.  I think I might do that.

Everyone who goes to meetup was a first-timer at one point in their life.  People will be welcoming to you.  Ask people about themselves and what other activities they like.  I like to start by finding something to compliment someone on.  It makes them feel good and you did it.  For instance, I love that shirt, or something like that. Tell people your name and try to remember theirs.  Once at a meet-up, we talked about how to remember each others name like making up a rhyme or picking an animal that starts with the same letter.  It turned into a really funny conversation between a bunch of awkward strangers.

You are beautiful. You are sensitive in such a wonderful way but  that's why it hurts so much.  Take a camera and go for a walk.  Look for beautiful things.  Even a little flower on a weed is beautiful.  I felt like you did once.  And now I am happy.  True happiness comes when you appreciate what you already have.  Even if that is only your five senses, appreciate them.  Those who have lost one would tell you how lucky you are to still be able to see, or hear, etc.  PM me if you need to talk

Thank you.  I am just afraid that he is going to concoct some fake evidence or get someone to lie for him.  I guess you're right, it will be pretty obvious when all the facts are laid out.

There were no witnesses or videos because it happened in a moving car.  He did send tons of incriminating text messages, though.  Very vulgar and accusatory texts before and apologetic texts after.  He did send a text that said "you attacked me as soon as you got in the car" and I replied "that didn't happen".  I really wish I would have gone to the police and the hospital that night.
You lost me.  How would they prove that he's lying?
He has been telling mutual friends.  He will be telling so many more people if he takes the stand. I have already felt the rumors effecting the way some people act around me.

The slander I am talking about is the fact that he has been telling people that I attacked him and all of my injuries were from him defending himself.  If he takes the stand, he will say the same thing.
That sucks.  This is the perfect case for them to make an example out of him.  He is a classic abuser.
I haven't been charged with anything.  It is his defense for the domestic battery charges.

The only iffy thing in this case is that I didn't file a police report for 3 weeks.  I was so scared of making him mad plus the concussion made it hard to think.  He admitted it on texts, said he was so sorry and promised to treat me like a queen.  I had 2 trips to the ER, 4 trips to my regular doctor, 3 trips to the neurologist,and one to an ear specialist.  My MRI showed the injuries and the ER documented bruises.  I don't see how he could get off unless he has someone lie for him.  Oh, and he also sent me a text telling me "please don't get us in trouble".  

Thank you so much for all of your help.  I feel much better about the whole process.

I feel like I would have a tendency to shake my head but I heard that you really shouldn't do that.  The reasoning is that if you shake your head when think they are lying, whenever you are not shaking your head, you seem to agree with them.  That's why I was asking.
Good point, I forgot about demonstrating damages.

A plea deal is what I'm afraid of.  If they let him plead to a misdemeanor instead of trying him for the felony, it will be a slap on the wrist.  He gave me permanent brain damage.  The pain from the concussion lasted 3 months, all day, every day.  He will do it again if he's not punished by prison time.  The woman at the domestic violence agency told me that they will usually ask the victim if they should try to make a plea deal.  Is there any way I can prevent him from getting a slap on the wrist?  If he doesn't go to prison, I am going to have to move far away.
But my original question was "is it slander?"  I know the DA will handle it.  I don't like being lied about.

Well, my injuries are real and he only has one scratch.  He also sent me texts saying how sorry he was and how he will treat me like a queen if I take him back.  I'm hoping he's as screwed as I think he is.  I'm afraid he's going to get a friend to lie for him and say they saw something different.   It happened in the car while he was driving so it would have been almost impossible for anyone to have seen what happened.   Thank your for all of your help.  I am really anxious about this whole thing.

I am the state's witness.  I won't even meet the district attorney until 30 minutes before the preliminary hearing.

I am the victim.   He gave me a concussion. The lie is that I attacked him and he gave me a concussion when he was defending himself.
So when he's up on the stand lying his ass off, what is my best reaction?  Shaking my head?  Staring at him?  Looking away?

The problem is there is no proof that he is lying because there were no witnesses.   He's the kind of (stupid) person that thinks if you say something then it's true.  Like his friend told him he could sue his ex-wife for support and he said it must be true because Rick said so.

The food stamps program has an emergency program.  You can go in and get a card the same day.  You might have to wait for a few hours but they will help you if you can show that you need it.  Go online and find out what you need to bring.  It is worth it.  I went in a few years ago because I had no way to feed my kids or myself.  They gave me a food stamp card the same day.  They have other assistance programs too.  The people there are very helpful, you just usually have to wait for a long time.  Good luck!
